svg.title: LLaMAR SAR experiment evaluation lifecycle
svg.desc: Source-grounded lifecycle for one sar_orch experiment run, its three concurrent execution and logging lanes, terminal classification and cleanup, plus an independent benchmark batch branch that repeatedly starts experiment.py subprocesses and aggregates per-run results.
svg.text: LLaMAR SAR 实验评测生命周期
当前 checkout 源码：单次 run 控制脊柱 · 三条并行泳道 · 独立 Benchmark 批处理分支

g.text: 1 SARBarrier → SAREnv.reset() 2 ExperimentLogger + run dir / metadata.json
3 SandboxPolicy(off | workspace) 4 coordinator first → workers start/register
workers connect to coordinator; wait for registration before submit
submit 后同时推进：orchestration · worker execution · poll + step logging
submit_task stream · finish_task / error → poll flags
N actions sync · 60s missing → NoOp · observations back

g.aria-label: 真实 poll exit、终止分类、最终指标和清理
g.text: 真实 poll exit → classify → finally
classifier precedence and cleanup are from current experiment.py

g.aria-label: Benchmark repeated subprocess runs and aggregation
g.text: repeated subprocess runs · run_single() calls experiment.py · not cleanup → benchmark
Proposal only — not active runtime nodes: EnvironmentAdapter · Metrics · StepResult (experiment_design.md)

path.aria-label: experiment.py CLI contract reused by independent benchmark subprocess entry

svg.text: benchmark reuses the experiment.py CLI contract
